name: Chronomancer: The Bieko Effect cuts the named cooldowns by 10% every 2 sec while Hasten lasts (#1219)
contract: The Bieko Effect 706099 (Spell.dbc, family 28, passive) reads 'While Hasten is active the cooldowns of Dimensional Divergence, Temporal Anomaly, and Temporal Focus are reduced by $707312s1% every $712371t1 sec.' Its only effect is aura 42 triggering 712371 (TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, aura 23 every 2000 ms for DurationIndex 29 = 12000 ms, the same duration as Hasten 801304), which triggers 707312. 707312 carries three effects of the custom type 192 with BasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10 and MiscValue 802790 Dimensional Divergence, 806315 Temporal Anomaly and 806165 Temporal Focus. Effect 192 is 'reduce the remaining cooldown of MiscValue by BasePoints percent' (Profound Enlightenment 680953: 'reducing the remaining cooldown of Testaments by $s1%'). Before the fix 706099 had ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row, so casting Hasten applied nothing, and effect 192 was EffectNULL. Expected: casting Hasten applies 712371 to the Chronomancer (fails before the fix), and its six ticks each cut the remaining cooldown of Temporal Focus and Temporal Anomaly by 10%: with every cooldown started together, the talented caster's remaining cooldown ends at 0.9^6 of a remaining cooldown that already runs 12 sec behind, about 0.51 of the control's (5 ticks would give about 0.56, 7 about 0.46). Timeguard 804441 is a negative control: the stale Hasten text names it, but 707312 does not, so its cooldown must match the control's. Dimensional Divergence needs a second player to swap with and is not cast here.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Learning The Bieko Effect applies its passive
SETUP: Temporal Focus is on its 120 sec cooldown for the talented caster
SETUP: Temporal Anomaly is on its 120 sec cooldown for the talented caster
SETUP: Timeguard is on its 120 sec cooldown for the talented caster
SETUP: Timeguard is on its 120 sec cooldown for the control caster
Hasten is on the talented caster
DISCRIMINATING: casting Hasten starts The Bieko Effect's periodic reduction
The control caster, without the talent, gets no periodic reduction
Let all six 2 sec ticks of the 12 sec effect land
The periodic reduction ends with Hasten's 12 sec
DISCRIMINATING: six 10% cuts leave Temporal Focus at about half the control's cooldown
DISCRIMINATING: six 10% cuts leave Temporal Anomaly at about half the control's cooldown
Negative control: Timeguard is not in 707312's list and keeps the control's cooldown
